title: Make your first edit to OpenStreetMap
summary: A beginner-friendly tutorial guiding users to make their first contribution to OpenStreetMap, the collaborative open-source mapping project. It likely uses the JOSM desktop editor and provides a plugin website wizard tool to help newcomers get started with map editing.
problem_solved: Lowers the barrier to entry for beginners wanting to contribute to OpenStreetMap, making their first map edit approachable.
why_valuable: Encourages community participation in open-source geospatial data by simplifying the onboarding experience for new mappers.
